# `Q-1-25` — Whitespace in Tag

> A YAML tag contains whitespace around a component.

## What this means

Quarto's configuration tags are written in compact form, with no
spaces between or around their components: `!prefer_md`, not
`! prefer_md` or `!prefer _ md`. The YAML parser usually strips
whitespace before Quarto sees the tag, but this check exists for
the rare cases where some whitespace survives.

## Why this happens

If you see this error, the most likely cause is a stray space
inserted by an editor or by hand-editing. The recognized tag
components themselves never contain spaces.

## How to fix

Remove the whitespace from the tag. The tag, including underscores,
should be one continuous token immediately after the `!`.

## Related

- [`Q-1-24`](Q-1-24.qmd) — empty tag component: caused by misplaced underscores,
  often discovered in the same edit that introduces stray
  whitespace.
- [`Q-1-26`](Q-1-26.qmd) — invalid tag character: a broader form of the same
  check, which catches non-alphanumeric, non-underscore characters
  in the tag.
